summary: Joe Bev has made history at Sandbach United, scoring a brace in the last match to become the club's all-time leading goalscorer with 56 goals, breaking James Kirby's previous record of 54 - an incredible achievement in just two seasons. The Ramblers are looking to build on this momentum with back-to-back wins as they travel to Foley FC. With the whole season still ahead, fans will be eager to see how many more goals Joe can add to his impressive tally.
